notes.title: Laboratory 1.075
notes.content:
Added an option to hold the shoot button instead of rapidly pushing it.
With that being said - it's important to know that you can reach higher shooting speed by pressing it really fast. your choice.

tags.feature: Added an option to hold the shoot button instead of rapidly pushing it.

notes.title: Laboratory 1.07
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes:
- The brain boss has a new charging animation before lunching red lasers.

Bug Fixes:
- "Start Game" button used to not work first time the game is opened. this is now fixed.
- Game used to be normal difficulty level the first time you open it no matter what level you choose, this is now fixed.
- Before update 1.07 you could not get an hard level achievement on steam if you defeated the same boss on normal or easy levels before, this is now fixed.

Many more bugs fixed and gameplay tweaks were made.
Please contact me for any bugs you find.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41774076/6b9b29030e140b544986b173826b9eb30fd8ec7c.gif[/img]

notes.title: Laboratory 1.06
notes.content:
Gameplay Changes:
- Dash cooldown was reduced.
- "Teleporter 2.0" power-up was buffed.

[b]Visual Changes:
- Brain's tentacles animation was replaced from a simple pixel art animation to a procedural animation.[/b]

Other Changes:
- Improved performance.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JFHmJ2K/newGif.gif[/img]

notes.title: Laboratory 1.04
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed:
- Moving the character after losing to the final boss was and laggy at some cases, not anymore.

Key Binding Changes:
- The default shooting button was changed from Up Arrow ↑ to [b]Left Mouse Button[/b].
- You can use your mouse buttons to bind actions in the game.

Gameplay Changes:
- Exploding eyeballs will now collide with walls.

notes.title: Laboratory 1.03
notes.content:
Bugs Fixed: 
- Frame rate drop when shooting the final boss.

Gameplay Changes:
- Exploding eyeballs won't stop your lasers, they will not collide.
This was changed because player used to think that if you shoot the eyeballs, they will explode faster, and this is not true.

tags.bug: - Frame rate drop when shooting the final boss.

tags.balance_change: - Exploding eyeballs won't stop your lasers, they will not collide.

notes.title: Laboratory 1.02
notes.content:
Bugs fixed, and a few gameplay changes. Including one big gameplay change:
- until now you could not see the health of the boss while battling him, unless you beat the heart boss and pick the specific upgrade to gain this ability. This is now no longer the case and you can always see your enemy's health bar. The upgrade of the Heart boss was replaced with a new one called "Science's Revenge"

And more.

notes.title: Laboratory Version 1.01
notes.content:
Many bugs fixed, including:
- Heat bar not reset after level restart.
- "Ouch" and "Ouch!" achievements unlock instantly after 1 death.
- Game speed wont return to normal after restart in the final boss.
- typographical errors fixed.
And many more.
